name: Anime Ability Arena
desc:
Welcome to Anime Ability Arena.

Jump into fast-paced battles, use anime-inspired powers, and defeat players to earn Yen. Use your Yen to unlock new characters, test different movesets, and find the ability that matches your fighting style.

🔥 Game Features
20 playable characters
Unique ability movesets
Fast arena combat
Earn Yen by fighting
More characters and updates coming soon

🎮 Supported Devices
PC, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox, and PlayStation

⭐ Like and favorite the game for more updates!

⚠️ Rules
No exploiting, cheating, alt farming, or bug abusing. Breaking the rules can lead to a permanent ban.

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Farm, Invincibility, Auto Attack n Mor
scripts.features:
This is a comprehensive exploit script for an anime fighting game that provides automated combat, farming, and utility features through a customizable GUI. The script includes an auto-farm system that orbits targets at adjustable speeds and distances while automatically attacking, with smart targeting that scores enemies based on health, distance, line-of-sight, and hardened status. Premium-locked features like No Cooldown and Invincibility are greyed out in the interface for non-subscribers, with the former removing all ability cooldowns, dashes, stuns, and silences when active. Defense features include anti-ragdoll, anti-void teleportation back to safe positions, and client-side health locking with knockback cancellation. Movement enhancements offer speed hacking through the game's multiplier system, infinite jumping, noclip, and full WASD flight with adjustable speed. Visual features provide enemy ESP with health/distance billboards and hitbox debugging through the game's native renderer. The script includes a save/load system, theme manager, kill tracking, a draggable toggle button showing ping and runtime, plus hotkeys for menu toggling (RightShift) and farm toggling (T).
